bodyHtml:
A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

Free, open source and performant multi-agent harness, works with your existing subscriptions (uses hourly limits). It wraps the CLI agents you already use — Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and 9 more — and runs an office of your clones on your own machine.
